name: writing
description: Personal writing voice and user-facing error text. Skills: writing-voice (documents, guides, email, chat, tickets, and commit messages), writing-error-messages (user-facing errors in three parts: what happened, why, and next steps the user should take). Use voice when drafting or revising prose on the user's behalf; use error-messages for UI, API, or log user text.
